description: Data-only water, wastewater, and electrically heated materials technology mappings.

exergy-imperative-component-methods.title: The Exergy Imperative component accounting methods
exergy-imperative-component-methods.applicable_boundary: Single-input equipment mapping at explicitly selected delivered-energy and useful-output boundaries
exergy-imperative-component-methods.note: Mappings contain no site performance, exposure, or design defaults.

doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.title: U.S. DOE Improving Pumping System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, Second Edition
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.license: U.S. Government work; verify sourcebook-specific third-party notices
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.applicable_boundary: Pump and motor input electricity to hydraulic work for industrial centrifugal pumping systems
doe-industrial-pump-sourcebook.note: The sourcebook describes pump efficiencies from about 35% to above 90% and includes worked screens using 90% motor efficiency. The bundled prior multiplies those two quantities and is deliberately broad.

doe-industrial-fan-sourcebook.title: U.S. DOE Improving Fan System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry
doe-industrial-fan-sourcebook.license: U.S. Government work; verify sourcebook-specific third-party notices
doe-industrial-fan-sourcebook.applicable_boundary: Fan mechanical input to useful airstream power for forward-curved centrifugal fans
doe-industrial-fan-sourcebook.note: The sourcebook reports 55%-65% for forward-curved fans. The bundled equipment screen multiplies this by the pump sourcebook's illustrative 90% motor efficiency; oxygen transfer and treatment performance are excluded.

doe-metalcasting-energy-profile.title: U.S. DOE Energy and Environmental Profile of the U.S. Metalcasting Industry
doe-metalcasting-energy-profile.license: U.S. Government work; verify report-specific third-party notices
doe-metalcasting-energy-profile.applicable_boundary: Coreless induction-furnace electricity to energy utilized in ferrous-metal melting
doe-metalcasting-energy-profile.note: The report states electrical-power utilization exceeding 80%; another DOE aluminum report describes approximately 90% induction melting. The range is a cross-material equipment screen.

technology.label: Electric water pump
technology.boundary: Electricity at motor input to useful hydraulic or shaft work as explicitly declared

efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of 35%-90% pump range multiplied by illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of the published pump range endpoints and illustrative motor efficiency

applicability.technology: Industrial centrifugal pump and electric motor
applicability.boundary: Motor electrical input to pump hydraulic output near a declared operating point

efficiency.note: Very broad fallback: efficiency depends strongly on pump size, type, wear, motor, and distance from best-efficiency point.

technology.label: Wastewater aeration system
technology.boundary: Electricity input to declared pneumatic/mechanical useful work; oxygen-transfer performance requires a separate process model

efficiency.source_version: DOE fan sourcebook and illustrative 90% motor efficiency
efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of forward-curved fan range multiplied by illustrative motor efficiency
efficiency.range_basis: Products of the 55%-65% fan range and 90% illustrative motor efficiency

applicability.technology: Forward-curved centrifugal blower and electric motor
applicability.boundary: Motor electrical input to airstream mechanical power; diffuser, basin, and oxygen transfer excluded

efficiency.note: This is not oxygen-transfer efficiency or wastewater-treatment effectiveness.

technology.label: Membrane separation system
technology.boundary: Electricity input to minimum separation work; composition and recovery must be supplied for a separation-exergy calculation

technology.label: Electric-arc furnace
technology.boundary: Delivered electricity to declared high-temperature useful heat; feedstock chemical and phase-change terms require explicit streams

technology.label: Induction heater
technology.boundary: Delivered electricity to declared useful process heat at the heated material boundary

efficiency.source_version: DOE metalcasting and aluminum industry reports
efficiency.statistic: Midpoint of greater-than-80% ferrous and approximately-90% aluminum induction references
efficiency.range_basis: Rounded cross-material equipment endpoints; not an empirical confidence interval

applicability.technology: Coreless induction heating or melting of conductive metal
applicability.boundary: Delivered electricity to heat utilized in the metal; holding and material yield losses excluded

efficiency.note: Material, coupling, coil design, power supply, charge condition, and holding time strongly affect performance.

metadata.default_policy: explicit performance and process-state inputs required
